xs.push(fn); listeners.set(type, xs); };\n+  const remove = (type, fn) => listeners.set(type, (listeners.get(type) || []).filter(x => x !== fn));\n+  const root = { classList: { add: x => classes.add(x), remove: x => classes.delete(x) } };\n+  const document = {\n+    documentElement: root, visibilityState: visibility, readyState: 'complete',\n+    addEventListener: add, removeEventListener: remove, querySelectorAll: () => [],\n+  };\n+  const motionListeners = [];\n+  const motion = { matches: reduced, addEventListener: (_, fn) => motionListeners.push(fn) };\n+  const window = {\n+    matchMedia: () => motion, addEventListener: add,\n+    setTimeout: fn => { timer = fn; return 1; }, clearTimeout: () => { timer = undefined; },\n+  };\n+  const context = { window, document, IntersectionObserver: function () {}, console };\n+  vm.runInNewContext(prepare, context);\n+  if (loadReveal) vm.runInNewContext(reveal, context);\n+  return {\n+    classes, window,\n+    fire(type, event = {}) { for (const fn of [...(listeners.get(type) || [])]) fn(event); },\n+    expire() { if (timer) timer(); },\n+    setVisible() { document.visibilityState = 'visible'; this.fire('visibilitychange'); },\n+    reduce() { motion.matches = true; for (const fn of motionListeners) fn({ matches: true }); },\n+  };\n+}\n+\n+const assert = (ok, msg) => { if (!ok) throw new Error(msg); };\n+let s = scenario();\n+assert(s.classes.has('home-hero-prepared'), 'normal: prepare missing');\n+s.fire('pageshow');\n+assert(s.classes.has('home-hero-started'), 'normal: did not start');\n+assert(s.window.homeHeroState.started, 'normal: state not once-only');\n+s.fire('pageshow');\n+assert(s.classes.has('home-hero-started'), 'normal: repeat altered completion');\n+\n+s = scenario({ visibility: 'hidden' });\n+s.fire('pageshow');\n+assert(!s.classes.has('home-hero-started') && s.classes.has('home-hero-prepared'), 'hidden: started early');\n+s.setVisible();\n+assert(s.classes.has('home-hero-started'), 'hidden: did not start on visibility');\n+\n+s = scenario({ reduced: true });\n+assert(!s.classes.has('home-hero-prepared'), 'reduced: content hidden');\n+s.fire('pageshow');\n+assert(!s.classes.has('home-hero-started'), 'reduced: animation enabled');\n+\n+s = scenario({ loadReveal: false });\n+assert(s.classes.has('home-hero-prepared'), 'failure: not initially prepared');\n+s.expire();\n+assert(!s.classes.has('home-hero-prepared'), 'failure: did not fail open');\n+\n+s = scenario({ visibility: 'hidden', loadReveal: false });\n+s.expire();\n+assert(s.classes.has('home-hero-prepared'), 'hidden failure: failed open while hidden');\n+s.setVisible();\n+assert(!s.classes.has('home-hero-prepared'), 'hidden failure: did not fail open when visible');\n+\n+console.log('hero lifecycle scenarios: PASS');\n*** End Patch";
